card.title: Designated Reality Check
card.instruction: Return automatically to translating every bizarre development into practical consequences, even when everyone else seems comfortable with it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your floating relatives still need place cards. I'll get string.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need the upstairs seating plan too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wonderful. Aunt June can finally avoid Uncle Peter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if they stop on different floors. Which one ordered the vegetarian meal?

mechanism: A automatically converts floating relatives and their welcome separation into seating, floor and meal-delivery problems.
confusable: Unlike a character alarmed by impossibility, A focuses on its ordinary logistical consequences even when B welcomes it.
comparison: The relatives alternative manages movement across floors and dietary service; the fountain alternative turns a magical solution into a maintenance rota.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
